messages.subject: For Stephane Bancel | Biotechnology, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Moderna Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stephane Bancel, Chief Executive Officer.

Moderna operates at the intersection of biotechnology, governments, regulators, health systems and strategic investment. That complex external environment aligns closely with my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global-affairs stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Moderna's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Moderna.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
